news.title: Odisha CM inaugurates two affordable housing projects for urban poor
news.para: Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi inaugurated two affordable housing projects to support urban poor families. These housing units will be part of a broader initiative under the 'PMAY-Urban BANDHU' scheme. The projects at Ghatikia and Gadakana consist of over 1,600 affordable housing units with extensive facility investments. The government aims to improve living conditions and social status for slum dwellers and their families.

news.title: Karnataka high court upholds cancellation of OCs for 33 incomplete villas in Hoskote
news.para: The High Court confirmed the decision of the Samethanahalli gram panchayat to revoke the occupancy certificates for 33 villas in the Raffles Park project, citing substantial non-compliance with regulations. The villas were deemed unfit for occupation as they were incomplete. Following an inspection, the court mandated an investigation into potential misconduct by officials and architects, with possible disciplinary measures pending the inquiry's results.

news.title: With 90% of its developable land utilised, New Noida to come up in over 20,000 hectares
news.para: The Noida Authority has unveiled plans for a massive 20,000-hectare expansion dubbed New Noida. This venture aims to meet the rising industrial demands and is projected to generate between 500,000 to 600,000 jobs by 2030. The project will kick off with land acquisition in phases, boosting vertical development in established areas.

news.title: Gurugram: Encroachments outside 120 houses removed in South City-2, illegal stilt+4 building sealed
news.para: An anti-encroachment drive was conducted by the Department of Town and Country Planning in Gurgaon. This operation targeted unauthorized structures at 120 houses in South City-2 and sealed a building in Vatika India Next. The enforcement focused on removing obstructions on internal roads that hindered movement for vehicles and pedestrians. Structures like staircases and sheds were cleared to preserve designated road space.

news.title: Lucknow development body registration camp sees 107 allottee deeds executed on opening day
news.para: A special registration camp was organized by the Lucknow Development Authority to assist property allottees. The camp aimed to facilitate the registration of residential and commercial properties for many applicants. After the first day, 107 allottees had successfully registered their properties with the assistance available. Officials noted challenges for allottees who had not completed the registration process previously.

news.title: Gurugram: HERC orders audit of ATS Triumph's power bills since 2019, directs refund of excess charges
news.para: In a significant move, the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission has initiated an audit of the electricity bills at ATS Triumph in Gurgaon after residents reported discrepancies and excessive charges. The commission has called out the developer and DHBVN for not addressing these problems effectively, insisting on refunds for the overpayments.

news.title: Existing home sales rise in USA in September; higher mortgage rates dim outlook
news.para: Existing home sales in the US showed an unexpected increase in September, mainly due to revised August figures. Mortgage rates reached nearly 7.5%, contributing to ongoing affordability challenges for buyers. A rise in housing supply highlights weakened demand as inventory returned to pre-pandemic levels. Median home prices reached the highest September record at $417,500, stressing the affordability crisis.

news.title: Prestige Estates' pre-sales rise 20% to ₹7,225 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Prestige Estates Projects reported pre-sales of ₹13,804 crore in H1 FY27, including ₹7,225 crore in Q2. The company plans launches with more than ₹40,000 crore of potential sales value across Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Chennai and Hyderabad over the next two quarters.

news.title: Godrej Properties, RC Group and BMC inaugurate pedestrian corridor at Bandra Bay
news.para: Godrej Properties and RC Group have teamed up with BMC to launch a new pedestrian corridor in Bandra Bay. This initiative is part of the broader Bandra Bay Beautification Initiative, which focuses on enhancing pedestrian safety and accessibility. The inauguration featured a community wellness program with activities designed for families and children.

news.title: Prayagraj development body plans township along Prayagraj-Rewa highway
news.para: Prayagraj Development Authority has initiated plans for a high-tech township adjacent to the Iradatganj airstrip. The development is part of an expansion scheme under Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath.

news.title: Thiruvananthapuram: Karimadom Colony housing project gets DAC nod
news.para: The district-level planning committee approved a rehabilitation project for 128 families in Karimadom Colony. After delays, the city corporation will now release funding for the project to commence. Construction will include four buildings, each containing 32 flats for families needing better housing. Concerns about accessibility for elderly residents have been raised, prompting discussions on design modifications.

news.title: Protests across Buxar over PMAY-Gramin beneficiary list
news.para: Villagers and public representatives in Buxar district protested against the provisional beneficiary list of PMAY-G. They alleged that deserving families were excluded while affluent households were wrongly included in the list. Public representatives demanded a fresh review of the list and transparency in the verification process. Officials stated that the verification of beneficiaries is ongoing and that objections will be examined.

news.title: Adani begins construction of 10,432 Dharavi rehabilitation homes in Mumbai
news.para: Pranav Adani conducted the bhoomi poojan for a transformative housing project designed to rehabilitate residents of Dharavi. This significant undertaking will consist of 10 towers that house 10,432 apartments and 1,379 commercial units across an expansive 22 acres. As part of the in-situ rehabilitation scheme, qualifying residents will benefit from 350 square feet homes, complete with contemporary amenities to uplift family living standards.

news.title: India office net absorption rises 2% to 42.9 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Net office absorption across India’s top seven cities rose 2% year-on-year to 42.9 million sq ft during January-September 2026. Coworking emerged as the largest occupier segment with a 26% share, while office vacancy declined to 15.15% and average rentals increased 8%.

news.title: Shree Cement commissions three MTPA grinding unit in UAE with AED 115 million investment
news.para: Shree Cement has commissioned a 3 MTPA cement grinding facility at its subsidiary Union Cement Company in Ras Al Khaimah, taking its UAE cement capacity to 7 MTPA from 4 MTPA and overall capacity to 76.3 MTPA.

news.title: Puravankara pre-sales rise 62% to ₹2,136 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Puravankara reported pre-sales of ₹2,136 crore in Q2 FY27, up 62% year-on-year, while collections increased 24% to ₹1,301 crore. The company added projects with estimated GDV of ₹8,900 crore during the quarter and ₹14,100 crore in H1 FY27.

news.title: Pune civic body to levy extra property tax on developers of illegal constructions as penalty
news.para: In Pune, developers engaged in unlawful construction practices will now incur extra penalties on their property taxes. The Pune Municipal Corporation intends to use these additional funds to offset demolition costs. Although notices have been dispatched, compliance is significantly lacking, compounded by a strong demand for affordable housing and insufficient local authority supervision. Experts warn that these collection strategies may fail without proper recovery of outstanding dues.
